_note: Starting-point checklists, NOT religious or cultural authority. Families differ. Edit this file with your elders and purohit.

requirements.label: Priest (purohit) booked
requirements.why: The purohit leads the ceremony and fixes the exact muhurtham (auspicious time). Without a confirmed booking, the date and timing cannot be locked.

requirements.label: Muhurtham time confirmed with the purohit
requirements.why: Hair, makeup, guest arrival, catering and photography are all planned backwards from this time.

requirements.label: Mandapam / venue booked
requirements.why: Venues for peak wedding dates are booked far ahead, and everything else depends on the location.

requirements.label: Bride's wedding saree ready
requirements.why: The saree is the longest-lead outfit item and the blouse and fall work cannot start without it.

requirements.label: Blouse stitched, fitted and altered
requirements.why: Tailoring needs time for stitching, a fitting and alterations. A delay here is hard to recover.

requirements.label: Bridal jewellery sorted
requirements.why: Jewellery is often custom-made or sized, and it must be collected and secured before the day.

requirements.label: Mangalsutra ready
requirements.why: It is used during the ceremony itself, so it has to be ready and with the right person on the day.

requirements.label: Groom's outfit ready
requirements.why: Outfits need fitting time, and the groom's side may be shopping separately.

requirements.label: Ritual items (puja samagri, jeelakarra bellam, talambralu items)
requirements.why: Rituals cannot start if an item is missing, and some are hard to find at the last minute. Confirm the exact list with your purohit or elders.

requirements.label: Catering and menu finalised
requirements.why: Caterers need a final guest count and menu well before the day to source ingredients.

requirements.label: Photographer / videographer booked
requirements.why: Good photographers are booked months ahead, and the day cannot be repeated.

requirements.label: Decoration and flowers arranged
requirements.why: Decor teams need access to the venue ahead of time, so the schedule must be agreed with the venue.

requirements.label: Invitations sent
requirements.why: Guests, especially those travelling, need notice. Late invitations lower attendance.

requirements.label: Guest accommodation arranged
requirements.why: Out-of-town family need rooms close to the venue, and rooms near the venue fill up fast.

requirements.label: Bridal makeup and hair booked
requirements.why: Makeup artists take limited bookings per day and need the muhurtham time to plan the start.

requirements.label: Priest (purohit) confirmed
requirements.why: The purohit guides the ritual and confirms the timing.

requirements.label: Ritual items (turmeric and other items)
requirements.why: Items must be ready before the ritual begins. Confirm the exact list with elders.

requirements.label: Outfit for the ritual
requirements.why: Outfits for ritual days are easy to forget and can need stitching time.

requirements.label: Photographer booked
requirements.why: This is a once-only moment, so it needs coverage.

requirements.label: Mehendi artist booked
requirements.why: Applying bridal mehendi takes hours, and it needs to dry, so the artist's time slot drives the evening.

requirements.label: DJ / sound system arranged
requirements.why: Sound needs setup time and venue permission.

requirements.label: Performances and rehearsals planned
requirements.why: Group performances need several rehearsals, and everyone's availability is the hard part.

requirements.label: Outfits for the evening
requirements.why: Outfits may need stitching and alterations, and mehendi limits what can be worn.

requirements.label: Reception venue booked
requirements.why: The venue sets the guest capacity and the date.

requirements.label: Catering confirmed
requirements.why: The caterer needs a guest count and menu in advance.

requirements.label: Stage and decor
requirements.why: Stage decor needs setup time at the venue.

requirements.label: Couple's outfits
requirements.why: Reception outfits are different from ceremony outfits and need their own fitting.

requirements.label: Photographer booked
requirements.why: Reception photos are needed for family and guests.
